summary: Iteration 16 backend testing for TaskMint app. Verified new AdMob settings endpoints, admin /users?active=1 filter + referrals_count enrichment, admin /users/{id} referrals_count, /referrals & /transactions sub-endpoints, plus smoke checks on previously-existing endpoints. 12/12 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL (https://mint-tasks-sync.preview.emergentagent.com).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1550 lines — consider splitting into routers (admin, auth, admob, referrals) for maintainability.
GET /api/admob-settings has no caching headers; client polls on every app start. Consider a short Cache-Control to reduce load.
PUT /api/admin/admob-settings does no format validation on ad unit IDs (e.g. 'ca-app-pub-XXX/YYY'). A bad unit ID will silently break ads in production.
Active-users query has no index on users.last_activity_date — at scale a compound index on (last_activity_date, created_at) will speed up the admin dashboard.

auth_admin_login overwrites the current device-user's email/name/referral_code with the hardcoded admin profile — irreversibly mutates the underlying device-user row. A dedicated admin user separate from the device user would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient users prefixed with user_TEST_* and clean them up in finally blocks. AdMob settings are snapshotted before PUT and restored after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable test_iteration16.py covers AdMob settings (public + admin), admin users (active filter + referrals_count), and previously-existing endpoint smoke. Admin flow = POST /api/auth/device -> POST /api/auth/admin-login with the SAME bearer token. /api/links returns a DICT (config) not a list. /api/withdraw-settings returns a dict. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) is the env key actually present in frontend/.env.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The only pre-fix failure was a test-side wrong-type assertion on /api/links; fixed locally and rerun.
